release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.42 fixes the Generator navigation regression from v0.45.41. Generator is now a first-class eighth primary route between Profiles and Accounts in the authoritative router and primary-navigation model, mounts before navigation consolidation, and no longer inherits the previously active pane. This release also adds dedicated real-Chromium Generator navigation coverage that enters Generator from every other primary destination and requires Generator to be the only active pane before a release can pass Prebuild.
